Hi Samantha — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the files and we have two small verification items before Procurement/Finance can issue the PO: 

1) EIN format mismatch: our vendor onboarding system expects the EIN as a contiguous 9-digit string (no hyphens). The W-9 you sent lists the EIN with a hyphen (12-3456789). Could you confirm the nine-digit EIN in plain numeric form so we can match it in our payroll/vendor ledger?

2) Identity verification for the signatory: our standard practice for first-time non-US/US vendors (and to meet our audit) is a photo ID + a quick phone OTP to the registered contact to confirm the EIN holder. Please reply with a photo of the signatory government ID (front only is fine) and confirm a best contact phone number for a one-time SMS OTP. The verification call/text will be a single-step and is only to validate the EIN holder.

If you prefer, we can accept a notarized bank letter in lieu of the photo ID + OTP; you already attached a bank letter which helps, but we need either the notarized copy or the photo ID/OTP flow to complete the verification.

Timeline: once we have the plain-format EIN and either the Vendor_ID image or OTP confirmation (we run OTP within 24 hours), Procurement will be able to generate the PO within 48 hours.

Procurement ticket: PROC-7893 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-7893)

Thanks — happy to review a corrected W-9 if you want to upload it directly.

Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
